input_boundary: candidate_memories are the full retrieval corpus for one synthetic user; this dataset does not evaluate planner behavior
description: Curated retrieval cases using stable record IDs so retrieval quality can be measured independently of planner temporary indices.

cases.description: Direct lexical match retrieves an active goal.

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.
The user lives in Berlin.

cases.description: Semantic paraphrase with weak lexical overlap.
cases.query: I have gone back to eating meat.

candidate_memories.content: The user follows a vegetarian diet.
The user prefers working in the morning.

cases.description: A career change should retrieve the prior occupation despite limited shared vocabulary.
cases.query: I switched careers and now work as a product manager.

candidate_memories.content: The user is a software engineer.
The user is learning Python.

cases.description: Location correction retrieves the previous location fact.
cases.query: I now live in Berlin instead of Munich.

candidate_memories.content: The user lives in Munich.
The user's friend Nora lives in Berlin.

cases.description: Select the abandoned goal from several active goals.
cases.query: Running a marathon is no longer one of my goals.

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to exercise three times per week.
The user wants to run a marathon.
The user wants to improve their sleep routine.

cases.description: A scoped presentation goal retrieves the broader public-speaking goal.
cases.query: I specifically want to present confidently during work meetings.

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to become comfortable speaking in public.
The user wants to become a better leader.

cases.description: A named relationship query retrieves the correct relationship memory.
cases.query: I need to prepare for a conversation with my sister Nora.

candidate_memories.content: The user's sister Nora gives them honest feedback.
The user has weekly meetings with their manager.

cases.description: A combined message requires two distinct existing memories.
cases.query: I dropped my marathon goal and now prefer exercising in the evening.

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to run a marathon.
The user prefers exercising in the morning.
The user wants to improve their sleep.

cases.description: Deleted records are never returned even when they are the strongest lexical match.

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.
The user wants to improve their Spanish.

cases.description: An unrelated corpus should produce no results.
cases.query: I want help understanding attachment theory.

candidate_memories.content: The user lives in Berlin.
The user prefers exercising in the evening.

cases.description: The result set must respect the requested top-k limit.
cases.query: Tell me about my learning goals.

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.
The user wants to learn advanced Python.
The user wants to learn guitar.

cases.description: Reflection language retrieves an established conversation-avoidance pattern.
cases.query: Why do I keep putting off hard conversations?

candidate_memories.content: The user often avoids difficult conversations because they worry about upsetting people.
The user prefers organizing their thoughts before discussions.

cases.description: A career decision query retrieves a directly relevant value.
cases.query: Would accepting this role give me enough freedom to work independently?

candidate_memories.content: The user values autonomy in their career.
The user lives in Berlin.

cases.description: Entity-specific relevance should beat same-type distractors.
cases.query: I changed how I want to receive feedback at work.

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers receiving work feedback in writing.
The user prefers exercising in the morning.
The user prefers vegetarian meals.

cases.description: A zero limit deterministically returns no records.

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.
